description: Thumbnail grid where each tile opens a large gradient preview with metadata.

import { DownloadIcon, HeartIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/dialog" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const artworks = [ { id: "dawn", title: "Dawn Over Harbor", gradient: "from-amber-300 via-rose-400 to-violet-500", size: "4000 × 3000", }, { id: "tide", title: "Low Tide", gradient: "from-sky-300 via-cyan-400 to-emerald-500", size: "3600 × 2400", }, { id: "dusk", title: "Dusk Ridge", gradient: "from-indigo-500 via-purple-500 to-pink-500", size: "5120 × 2880", }, { id: "moss", title: "Moss Garden", gradient: "from-lime-300 via-green-500 to-teal-600", size: "3000 × 3000", }, ] export default function GalleryPreviewDialog() { return (
{artworks.map((art) => (
{art.title} {art.size} px · Uploaded by Mira Solberg
))}
) }
